HOW YOUR WORK MOVES / ONE SHARED WORKSPACE

One brief. A clear next step.

  1. Prepare your project brief and check its scope.
  2. Sign in and save it to your existing seller work queue. Your other records stay intact.
  3. Open your saved work. Visibility briefs enter Visibility & SEO; Studio and campaign briefs enter Marketing & social; collection briefs enter Product discovery; rental briefs enter Opportunities & gaps.
  4. Use Open in Studio on a marketing task to create or open its saved creative job. Review assets before delivery and record actual outcomes.

Saved briefs are proposed work. Saving does not take payment, upload the preview image, generate media or publish a campaign. The three capability tabs do not change your subscription.

Only the account that saves a brief can open its private work records. The Admin workroom retains owner access.
